item.title: Reika no Yakata ~Saimin Yuugi e no Shoutaijou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sister Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-03-22
  • スコア: 6.44/10 (85 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 麗華の館 ～催眠遊戯への招待状～
  • 英語名: Reika no Yakata Saimin Yuugi e no Shoutaijou

别名

  • Reika no Yakata Saimin Yuugi e no Shoutaijou

あらすじ

A sudden snowstorm forces Kyoichi and his sister Hime to seek shelter in a mysterious inn. Once inside, they discover that the two voluptuous owners Reika and Hitomi operate it as a high class brothel. They use hypnosis on Kyoichi to bring him into a world of pleasure, and when his lovely sister tries to rescue him, they also use hypnosis on her! Will they be able to escape?
